mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id reviewId, l.thumbnail thumbnail, r.review_rate rate, u.nickname nickname, DATE_FORMAT(r.write_date, '%Y.%m.%d') writeDate, l.name lectureTitle, r.content content FROM review r JOIN lecture l ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN user u ON u.user_id = r.writer_id WHERE writer_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET review_rate = #{rate}, content = #{content}, edite_date = NOW() WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (lecture_id, writer_id, review_rate, content) VALUES (#{lectureId}, #{userId}, #{rate}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT review_id as reviewId, review_rate as rate, content FROM review WHERE lecture_id = #{lectureId} AND writer_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.writer_id AS writerId, u.profilename, u.nickname, r.review_rate AS reviewRate, r.write_date AS writeDate, r.content FROM review AS r JOIN lecture AS l ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN user AS u ON u.user_id = r.writer_id WHERE l.lecture_id = #{lectureId}

SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.writer_id AS writerId, u.profilename, u.nickname, r.review_rate AS reviewRate, r.write_date AS writeDate, r.content FROM review AS r JOIN lecture AS l ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN user AS u ON u.user_id = r.writer_id WHERE l.lecture_id = #{lectureId} ORDER BY r.review_rate DESC

SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.writer_id AS writerId, u.profilename, u.nickname, r.review_rate AS reviewRate, r.write_date AS writeDate, r.content FROM review AS r JOIN lecture AS l ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN user AS u ON u.user_id = r.writer_id WHERE l.lecture_id = #{lectureId} ORDER BY r.review_rate ASC

SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.writer_id AS writerId, u.profilename, u.nickname, r.review_rate AS reviewRate, r.write_date AS writeDate, r.content FROM review AS r JOIN lecture AS l ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN user AS u ON u.user_id = r.writer_id WHERE l.lecture_id = #{lectureId} ORDER BY r.write_date DESC

SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, l.thumbnail, COALESCE(SUM(r.review_rate), 0) / COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS avgReviewRate, r.writer_id AS writerId, r.write_date AS writeDate, r.content FROM review AS r JOIN lecture AS l ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN user AS u ON u.user_id = l.uploader_id JOIN information_provider AS ip ON ip.information_provider_id = u.user_id WHERE ip.information_provider_id = #{userId} GROUP BY r.review_id, l.thumbnail, r.review_rate, r.writer_id, r.write_date, r.content
